summary: Tested the back-cover photo fix (no CCTV camera). Backend: 17/17 pytest pass. meta.back_photo is 'back_photo_v2.jpg'. GET /api/assets/back_photo_v2.jpg returns a 200 JPEG (880x1248). The tagline and summary are present. Looking at the image file itself, the ceiling, ceiling lights, CCTV dome and projector are all gone. Desktop 1920x800 flip: TOC -> profil-penulis lands on 225-226, the author photo shows, and btn-next-page reaches 'Hal. 229 / 229' and is then disabled. back-cover shows back_photo_v2 with the tagline 'There is no easy in becoming The New No. 1', the summary, the green tag line and the footer (Ongah Hermanto / happiness trading / mynalura.com). The text panel starts at y=398 of 624, well below the face, with no overlap and no overflow (scrollHeight 624 = clientHeight 624). Mobile 390x844 reading mode: .rv-back-scaled is 336x476, the back cover inside matches, the page does not scroll sideways, and the layout matches desktop. Regression: '/ 229' indicator and the front cover are OK. The v2 layout for the new content hash 81480ab829850375 is locked at 230 pages; the client only GETs it, no POST.

issues: A thin (~8-10px) beige/dark-grey sliver of the ceiling edge still shows along the top of back_photo_v2.jpg (darkest at the top-right corner). There is no CCTV or projector, but cropping about 15px more off the top would leave pure purple backdrop.
The 'There is' / 'NO Easy' letters on the backdrop sit right against the left edge of the page with object-fit: cover (cosmetic).
The header subtitle still says 'Profil Penulis' when viewing the back cover (page 229). Minor.

action_items: Optional: crop about 15px more off the top of back_photo_v2.jpg to remove the remaining ceiling-edge sliver.
Optional: change the header section label on the back cover.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/layout locks the first layout for any key, including versions the client doesn't use (v1). The old test_layout_lock.py hardcoded the hash and v1, and its POST of 1 junk page locked a junk layout for 81480ab829850375:v1 once the content hash changed. I deleted that one record (created by the test); the frontend uses v2, so no user was affected. Server-side validation of LAYOUT_VERSION and page count is still recommended.
